methodology: Complete FFN with privately shared input, weights and biases. Fresh masks in live runs; only final output opened. Public integer interval oracle proves accumulator ranges. Checked isolated-party replay excludes network latency and bandwidth. Floating baselines use the same activation setting. Activation ablation replaces SiLU/GELU with identity and retains the SwiGLU value projection and gate multiplication.
